_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. On a phone not signed in to a venue: Register a new venue, then follow Account checks: your business, Verify my identity (Stripe's ID and selfie check), Business and bank checks (Stripe's own screens), and Add a card for the 14-day free licence. While the back office's Stripe is in test mode, use Stripe's test ID images and test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. 2. Close the app half way and reopen More, Account checks: it should carry on where you stopped. 3. Once Stripe allows cards, try a payment over £250: it should be refused with the reason until every check has passed.
release_notes: Sign a new venue up in the app: verify your identity and your business with Stripe, connect the bank account your takings are paid into, and start with 14 days free. Account checks in More shows where your venue stands.
